WITH type_averages AS (
    SELECT production_type_code, AVG(unit_price) AS average_price
    FROM Products
    WHERE unit_price IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY production_type_code
), overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(unit_price) AS average_price
    FROM Products
), above_overall AS (
    SELECT t.production_type_code, t.average_price, o.average_price AS overall_average
    FROM type_averages t
    CROSS JOIN overall_average o
    WHERE o.average_price IS NOT NULL
      AND t.average_price > o.average_price
), kept_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(average_price) AS average_price
    FROM above_overall
), remaining AS (
    SELECT a.average_price, a.overall_average, m.average_price AS kept_mean
    FROM above_overall a
    CROSS JOIN kept_mean m
    WHERE m.average_price IS NOT NULL
      AND a.average_price > m.average_price
)
SELECT AVG(average_price) AS average_type_price,
       AVG(average_price - overall_average) AS average_above_overall,
       AVG(average_price - kept_mean) AS average_above_kept_mean
FROM remaining;
